note: Question bank. questions.json is generated from this file by tools/build-daily.js using least-recently-used rotation, so a question cannot reappear until every other question in its tier has been used. Grow the bank instead of replacing it. Questions marked src 'iq-measurer' are leveled-up derivatives of the text questions in github.com/Ksound22/iq-measurer (MIT); the SVG matrix questions were not usable here and were skipped, and the recall questions were rebuilt as manipulation questions because this app shows the stem and the choices together with no timer.
